search.py:565-609 adds _CLIP_DRIVE_FETCH_MAX=4096, _CLIP_DRIVE_FETCH_FACTORS=(4,16,64) and _drive_thumbnail_neighbours. For limit=50 that helper runs KNNs at k = 200, 800, 3200 and 4096, and after each one queries Embedding joined to IndexedFile, filtered to the drive and to active files. search.py:612-619 adds a drive keyword parameter, and search.py:674-675 routes to the helper when drive is set and include_scene_clip is false. The r5 revisions of I1, I3 and I9 describe this behaviour, but the Touch points section and §1/§6 (the drive filter stays in _build_results) were not updated.

specification_compliance: The touch-point list in docs/specs/search-knn-partition.md was not updated after the r5 drive-filter revision. The search() call site, execute_search_compare and the new helper fall outside it (TP-1 to TP-3 confirmed).
Spec §6 says the drive filter after the KNN stays in _build_results, and §7 describes the compare call without a drive. Both are stale against the r5 behaviour at search.py:674-675 and :2478.
potential_unspecified_behavior: execute_search_compare with no drive (drive=None) takes the unfiltered single-KNN path. The spec does not state this for compare.
_drive_thumbnail_neighbours stops after the first KNN that returns fewer rows than asked (partition exhausted), and returns [] as soon as one KNN returns nothing.
regression_risks: The compare endpoint's drive filtering has no automated test. A regression in execute_search_compare's drive argument would go unnoticed.
test_coverage: No test references execute_search_compare (grep over addons/intelligence/tests).
